top_signals.title: Singapore PM Vows More Support for Workers, Energy Security
top_signals.summary: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong pledged more support for workers and households, and said the government would step up efforts to secure energy supplies and attract investment as the city-state confronts growing global uncertainty.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
